subject: Sable selected and polished as the integrated frontend
body: The human changed direction to Sable. D integrated the Sable base b85cea6 and polish e0528e3 into local main: one primary Talk/End button with phase-aware awake mascot, optional typing and a chat panel that can minimize while voice continues. PDF rendering, citation navigation, fixed emergency and live voice routes are preserved. Production build/TypeScript PASS; a separate synthetic PDF browser journey returned live Q&A, opened cited page 2 and retained history. Suites skipped as requested; full microphone loop still needs human verification. Preview localhost:3108. Previous LabMate animation work remains uncommitted in its separate checkout and was not merged.
